# Feature request

Thanks for proposing a feature! Please provide the following information to help maintainers evaluate and implement it.

## Summary
Short description of the proposed feature.

## Motivation
Why is this feature important? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed solution
Describe the design, API changes, UX, or any implementation ideas.

## Alternatives considered
Describe other approaches or trade-offs.

## Drawbacks
Any potential downsides or backwards-compatibility concerns.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Clear and actionable description
- [ ] Design or API changes proposed
- [ ] Tests or docs updated as needed
